subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Should the official WhatsApp plugin support outbound stickers through a typed public action or media intent, rather than implicit captionless-WebP detection?
rationale: The current feature is absent, but choosing between a portable action, a plugin-specific explicit option, and automatic detection defines a lasting plugin/API contract and determines how media validation and backward-compatible image behavior should work.

options.title: Sponsor an explicit sticker intent
options.body: Add a typed WhatsApp sticker action or explicit media intent, keep ordinary WebP sends as images by default, and validate the selected contract with live plugin proof.

options.title: Allow automatic WebP routing
options.body: Treat qualifying captionless WebP media as stickers, accepting the semantic ambiguity and maintaining explicit image escape behavior and encoding rules.

options.title: Decline official support
options.body: Keep the current image-only behavior and leave any custom sticker workflow to a separately distributed integration.

recommendation.title: Sponsor an explicit sticker intent
recommendation.body: Add a typed WhatsApp sticker action or explicit media intent, keep ordinary WebP sends as images by default, and validate the selected contract with live plugin proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership spans both the WhatsApp send path and the shared media preparation path that the selected contract must coordinate.
